item.title: "President Lee Should Announce He Won't Run for Re-Election to Avoid Constitutional Amendment Controversy": 63% [NBS] (“이 대통령, 대선 불출마 선언해야 개헌 논란 없을 것” 63% [NBS])
item.description:
A poll released on the 27th found that 6 out of 10 people agree that there would be no controversy in the constitutional amendment process if President Lee Jae-myung stated his intention not to run in the next presidential election. <<> According to the National Barometer Survey (NBS) conducted by Embrain Public, K-Stat Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research from the 24th to the 26th on 1,001 people aged 18 or older (telephone interview method, with a margin of error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level), 63% of respondents said they "agree" with the statement that "President Lee should announce he will not run in the next presidential election to prevent the constitutional amendment debate from spreading into unnecessary controversy," more than double the 28% who said they "disagree." Even among respondents who said they support the Democratic Party of Korea, 51% said they "agree," compared to 41% who said they "disagree." <<> Regarding the government's real estate policies, negative responses were prevalent. On the question of "how effective the August 13 real estate measures will be in stabilizing housing prices in the future," 57% said they would have no effect. Only 34% said they would be effective. Regarding housing supply measures, 59% of respondents said they should "increase private housing supply by easing reconstruction and redevelopment regulations," while 29% said they should "increase public housing supply by utilizing urban sites such as Yongsan Park." <<> An evaluation of President Lee Jae-myung's handling of state affairs was 50% positive and 43% negative. In the same survey two weeks ago, positive evaluation was 49% and negative was 43%. For more details, refer to the website of the Central Election Poll Review Committee. <<> Jang Na-rae Reporter wing@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 다음 대통령선거 불출마 의사를 밝혀야 개헌 논의 과정에서 논란이 없을 것이라는 데 10명 가운데 6명이 동의한다는 여론조사 결과가 27일 나왔다.)

item.title: "Goal is the minister, if you don't cooperate, your public service career ends"… Yoon government's Board of Audit and Inspection manipulated audits on statistics and the West Sea incident (“목표는 장관, 협조 안 하면 공직생활 끝”…윤 정부 감사원, 통계·서해 감사 조작)
item.description:
The Board of Audit and Inspection (BAI) confirmed that coercive and manipulated audits took place during the Yoon Suk Yeol administration's audits into the "suspected manipulation of real estate statistics" (statistics audit) and the "West Sea public official killing case" (West Sea audit), and on the 27th took measures including criminal complaints against then-Secretary General Yoo Byung-ho and other leadership figures as well as working-level auditors. <<> The BAI's "Task Force (TF) for Follow-up Measures to the National Assembly Investigation" announced its findings that day, stating that it had sent investigation reference materials to the National Office of Investigation of the police regarding 10 individuals, including former BAI Chairman Choi Jae-hae, former Secretary General Yoo Byung-ho (current BAI member), former Secretary General Choi Dal-young, and Kim Sook-dong, then head of the Special Investigation Bureau (current head of the Review Management Division) who oversaw the statistics and West Sea audits. Nine auditors who served as working-level staff on the two audits were reported on charges of abuse of authority, obstruction of official duties through fraudulent means, and creating false official documents. The BAI also requested severe disciplinary action, including dismissal and removal from office, for these individuals. However, regarding the West Sea audit, the BAI stated that since the three-year disciplinary statute of limitations had expired, 12 individuals, including two bureau directors, received written warnings. <<> According to the TF's investigation findings, the statistics audit was conducted with the aim of targeting "higher-ups" such as Kim Soo-hyun and Kim Sang-jo, policy chiefs under the Moon Jae-in Blue House, and former Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Kim Hyun-mi, using coercive questioning of Blue House and ministry officials and manipulation of their answers. The statistics audit was carried out for about a year starting September 26, 2022, on the grounds that "the Moon Jae-in administration's Blue House and the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport exerted undue influence over the Korea Real Estate Board's statistics compilation process, manipulating the figures." A TF official said, "The statistics audit team believed that high-ranking Blue House and ministry officials pressured working-level staff or Korea Real Estate Board employees to manipulate the statistics, but we now view the evidence on orders from senior Blue House and ministry officials as largely contaminated or illegally obtained." <<> In fact, auditor A was found to have told a Blue House administrative officer, "This audit is targeting the policy chief and the minister. Simply put, it's like Toyotomi Hideyoshi asking Joseon for passage to attack Ming China" (referring to the phrase "jeongmyeonggado"), and to have said, "If you don't cooperate, your public service career is over." Senior auditor B, despite being a field supervisor with the duty to prevent coercive audits, was found to have entered the interrogation room of a ministry official during the statistics audit, thrown the question-and-answer statement and said, "You can't answer like this." <<> The TF also reported 220 cases in the statistics audit's request for investigation in which statements differing from actual testimony were cited, and third-party speculative statements were written in definitive language without confirmation from the individuals involved. The TF further stated, "During questioning in July 2023, auditor C shouted at a ministry director, saying things like 'Don't hide anything' and 'Don't make excuses,' creating an atmosphere of fear, even mentioning a past case where an audited official had committed suicide." It was also found that after the director declined to speak further, auditor C repeatedly recorded in the Q&A statement false answers to the effect that "all directors felt pressure and exerted influence on the Korea Real Estate Board to calculate lower fluctuation rates, distorting housing statistics." <<> Following that audit, the BAI requested investigations into 22 officials from the Moon Jae-in administration, and in March 2024, prosecutors indicted 11 individuals, including chiefs Kim Soo-hyun and Kim Sang-jo and former Minister Kim Hyun-mi, with trials currently underway. <<> Regarding the West Sea public official shooting incident (September 2020), the TF stated that during the West Sea audit, conducted over six months starting in June 2022 against the Coast Guard, the Ministry of National Defense, and the Ministry of Unification, the audit team arbitrarily provided the prosecution with the entire forensic clone, including private information such as personal KakaoTalk messages, without any filtering of information. Under judicial precedent, such evidence could be deemed illegally obtained and inadmissible. <<> Based on the TF's findings, the BAI also plans to review whether to reconsider the decisions of the two audits. Reconsideration is a system for correcting previous audit decisions when there are grounds of illegality or injustice. <<> Some BAI employees opposed the TF's announcement that day, saying it was inaccurate. In a statement, some employees who participated in the statistics audit and underwent TF questioning said, "We did not investigate with a predetermined conclusion but did our utmost to establish objective facts and approach the substantive truth," adding, "It is deeply regrettable and bewildering to be evaluated in a completely different light years later." They also stated, "The fact that housing statistics were arbitrarily adjusted under external pressure was proven based on objective data and testimonies from those involved." <<> The TF investigation was launched after the National Assembly's government inspection in April raised suspicions of coercive audits, abuse of digital forensics, and improper requests for investigation during the real estate statistics manipulation allegations and the West Sea audit. <<> Jang Ye-ji Reporter penj@hani.co.kr (감사원이 윤석열 정부 당시 ‘부동산 통계조작 의혹’(통계 감사)과 ‘서해 공무원 피살 사건’(서해 감사) 감사 과정에서 강압·조작 감사가 있었다는 사실을 확인하고, 유병호 당시 사무총장을 비롯한 지휘부와 실무 감사관들에 대해 27일 형사 고발 등의 조처를 했다.)

item.title: Cho Hyun: "Reviewing Deployment of Several Dozen Additional Rescue Workers to Nepal Disaster Areas" (조현 “네팔 피해지역에 구조대 수십명 추가 파견 검토”)
item.description:
With nine South Koreans missing and ten isolated due to landslides and flooding in Nepal, the government dispatched a rapid response team on the 27th and is discussing the deployment of additional rescue workers with the Nepalese government. It has been reported that the flooding was so powerful that all dams being built by Korean companies at the site were swept away. (네팔 산사태와 홍수로 한국인 9명이 실종되고 10명이 고립된 가운데 정부가 27일 신속대응팀을 파견하고 추가 구조대 파견도 네팔 정부와 논의하고 있다. 한국 기업이 현지에서 건설중이던 댐은 모두 유실될 정도로 강력한 홍수가 현장을 휩쓴 것으로 전해졌다.)

Foreign Minister Cho Hyun met with reporters at the Foreign Ministry building in Jongno-gu, Seoul, that day and said, "First, the rapid response team will assess the situation, and then we can deploy additional rescue workers in consultation with the Nepalese government," adding, "If we do send them, it will be on the scale of several dozen." Minister Cho also spoke by phone with Nepalese Foreign Minister Shishir Khanal that afternoon and requested cooperation for the swift rescue of South Koreans. (조현 외교부 장관은 이날 서울 종로구 외교부청사에서 기자들과 만나 “우선 신속대응팀이 상황을 파악한 뒤 네팔 정부와 협의해 추가로 구조대를 파견할 수 있다”면서 “보낸다면 수십명 규모일 것”이라고 말했다. 조 장관은 이날 오후 시시르 카날 네팔 외교장관과 통화하고 한국인의 신속한 구조를 위한 협조를 요청했다.)

Minister Cho said that when the landslides and flooding struck, "The isolated individuals and the missing were in somewhat different areas," adding, "There was a difference between those in higher and lower elevations." This means that those working at the upper part of the dam construction site became isolated, while those at the lower part lost contact. Minister Cho stated, "The dams we had built have all been lost." The sudden flooding caused by a glacial collapse was so immense that it swept away all the dams. (조 장관은 산사태와 홍수가 밀려왔을 당시 “고립된 이들과 실종된 이들은 조금 다른 지역에 있었다”면서 “지대가 높은 곳과 낮은 곳에 있던 차이가 있었다”고 말했다. 댐 건설 현장에서 위쪽에서 작업중이던 이들은 고립됐고 아래쪽에 있던 이들이 연락 두절됐다는 뜻이다. 조 장관은 “우리가 지어놨던 댐이 다 유실된 상태”라고 했다. 빙하 붕괴로 갑작스럽게 일어난 홍수에 댐이 다 쓸려갈 정도로 엄청난 충격이 있었던 것이다.)

Among the South Koreans at the scene, ten have evacuated along with about 200 foreign employees, including Nepalese nationals, and are waiting for rescue, according to the Foreign Ministry, which said they are safe together with the South Korean consul dispatched urgently to the area. The government plans to focus on the search and rescue of the nine people who have lost contact. (당시 현장에 있던 한국인 가운데 10명은 네팔인 등 외국인 직원들 200여 명과 함께 대피해 구조를 기다리고 있으며 현지에 급파된 우리 영사와 함께 안전한 상황이라고 외교부는 밝혔다. 정부는 연락이 두절된 9명의 수색과 구조에 집중할 방침이다.)

With the number of missing persons continuing to rise, attention is also turning to whether there are additional casualties among South Korean tourists. Around 20,000 South Koreans visit Nepal annually for tourism purposes, and the area where the accident occurred is in the Himalayan mountain region, known to have many tourists. The Foreign Ministry stated that aside from the nine who have lost contact and the ten awaiting rescue, no other damage to South Korean nationals has been reported so far, but added, "We are continuing to check whether there is any additional damage to our citizens." The South Korean Embassy in Nepal is a small mission, currently under a chargé d'affaires system with no ambassador, leaving it short of personnel to respond to a major incident like this. (실종자가 계속 늘고 있는 가운데 추가로 한국인 관광객들의 피해가 없는지에도 관심이 쏠리고 있다. 네팔은 매년 2만명 정도의 한국인이 관광 목적으로 방문하고 있고 이번 사고가 일어난 지역은 히말라야 산악지대에 있어 관광객이 많은 지역으로 알려졌다. 외교부는 현재까지는 연락 두절된 9명과 구조 대기 중인 10명 이외에 다른 우리 국민 피해상황은 접수되지 않았다면서도 “우리 국민의 추가 피해가 있는지 계속 확인하고 있다”고 밝혔다. 주네팔한국대사관은 소규모 공관으로 현재 대사도 없는 대리대사 체제여서, 이번처럼 큰 사고에 대응할 인력이 부족한 상태다.)

Earlier that day, the government dispatched a joint rapid response team of 11 members. Led by Lim Sang-woo, government representative for overseas nationals protection and consular affairs at the Foreign Ministry, the team comprises four Foreign Ministry officials, five firefighters, and two police officers, and will support the search and rescue of South Koreans on the ground. The team departed from Incheon Airport that day and, via Hong Kong, will arrive in Kathmandu, Nepal, late at night local time. (정부는 앞서 이날 11명 규모의 정부 합동 신속대응팀을 파견했다. 임상우 외교부 재외국민보호·영사담당 정부대표를 팀장으로 외교부 4명, 소방 5명, 경찰 2명 등으로 구성된 대응팀은 현지에서 한국인 수색·구조를 지원한다. 대응팀은 이날 인천공항을 출발해 홍콩을 거쳐 네팔 카트만두에 현지시각으로 밤 늦게 도착한다.)

Park Min-hee, Senior Reporter minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: "Reclaiming Power Impossible Without 'Zero-Point Reset'... Party Leadership Election Choosing Pragmatism and Expansion" (김민석 “‘영점이동’ 없인 재집권 불가능…실용·확장 선택한 당대표 선거”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 27th, "If we fail to achieve the change of a 'zero-point reset,' I believe it will be difficult for our party to be continuously entrusted with state affairs five or ten years from now." (김민석 더불어민주당 대표가 27일 “‘영점이동’의 변화를 해내지 않으면 우리 당이 5년, 10년 후에 지속적으로 국정을 맡기는 어렵다고 본다”고 밝혔다.)

Speaking at the "National Assembly Members' Workshop Ahead of the 2026 Regular Session" held at the Inspire Hotel in Yeongjong-gu, Incheon, Kim said, "Failing to reclaim power doesn't mean everything is a failure, but if we don't reclaim power, much of our efforts could be significantly reversed." He added, "We have reclaimed power once before. During President Kim Dae-jung's time, our factors for regaining power were, first, transforming into the Millennium Democratic Party after taking office and making substantial recruitments beyond our original support base. Second, adopting the New DJ line. That was the zero-point reset needed at that time." (김 대표는 이날 인천 영종구 인스파이어 호텔에서 열린 ‘2026년 정기국회 대비 국회의원 워크숍’에서 이렇게 말하며 “재집권을 못한다고 다 실패한 것은 아니지만, 재집권을 하지 않으면 우리의 모든 노력이 상당 정도 역행할 수 있다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “우리는 한번 재집권해봤다. 김대중 대통령 시절에 우리의 재집권 요인은 하나, 집권 후에 새천년민주당으로 탈바꿈하고 원래의 지지세력 위에 상당한 영입을 했다. 둘, 뉴 디제이(DJ) 노선을 취했다. 그 시점에 필요한 영점이동을 한 것”이라고 설명했다.)

After presenting a PowerPoint titled "'Expansion to the Center-Right & Structural Majority' vs. 'Unite! There Is No Center,'" Kim said, "Former leader Jeong Cheong-rae is a typical proponent of 'there is no center.'" He continued, "In contrast, with conservative forces having moved entirely to the extreme right after the December 3 (martial law) incident, there are two paths: expanding that territory and even making it structural to achieve a 'structural majority,' which could lead us down the road to the victory and reclamation of power we desire." (김 대표는 ‘중도보수 확장&구조적 다수’ 대 ‘단결하라! 중도는 없다’라는 제목의 파워포인트를 띄운 후 “정청래 전 대표는 대표적인 ‘중도는 없다’론자”라며 “그에 반해 12·3 (계엄) 이후에 보수 세력이 완전히 극단 우측으로 가버린 상황에서 그 영역을 확장하고 아예 구조적으로 만드는 ‘구조적 다수’까지 간다면 우리가 원하는 승리와 재집권의 길로 갈 수 있다는 두 가지 길이 있다”고 말했다.)

He added, "When discussing with former leader Jeong, we could resolve misunderstandings on all other points, but we reached a provisional conclusion that the issue of the center and the issue of a structural majority are difficult to compromise on between us." (이어 “정 전 대표님과 이야기를 하면서 다른 부분은 다 오해를 해소할 수 있는데, 중도에 대한 문제와 구조적 다수에 대한 문제는 서로 절충하기가 어렵다는 잠정적 결론을 서로 내렸다”고 덧붙였다.)

Furthermore, Kim said, "This government, which enjoyed remarkable approval ratings and overwhelming public support for a year, faced its party convention amid wobbling from the last election, with approval ratings falling, the stock market declining, and overall instability. At this turning point, party members chose the (Kim Min-seok) leadership, and I see that as a choice of course." He stressed, "The livelihood, pragmatism, and expansion line is the line of our government and the line of the party that has been chosen this time." (아울러 김 대표는 “1년 동안 놀라운 지지율을 가지고 국민의 압도적인 지지를 받았던 이 정부가 지난 선거에 흔들리면서 지지율 떨어지고 증시 떨어지고 전체적으로 흔들리는 상황에서 전당대회를 맞이했던 것”이라며 “이 분기점에 당원들이 (김민석) 지도부를 선택했고 저는 그것을 노선의 선택이라고 생각한다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “민생·실용·확장 노선이 우리 정부의 노선이고 이번에 선택된 당의 노선”이라고 강조했다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr Reporter Go Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Min-seok criticizes JTBC YouTube for 'trivializing the Inhyukdang case' (김민석, JTBC 유튜브 ‘인혁당 희화화’에 “선 넘었다”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, criticized remarks on JTBC's YouTube broadcast on the 27th that trivialized the "Inhyukdang Reconstruction Committee case," a representative judicial murder under Park Chung-hee's authoritarian regime, saying they "crossed the line." (김민석 더불어민주당 대표는 27일 제이티비시(JTBC) 유튜브 방송에서 박정희 독재정권의 대표적 사법살인 사건인 ‘인혁당 재건위 사건’을 희화화하는 발언이 나온 데 대해 “선을 넘었다”고 비판했다.)

In a Facebook post that day, Kim wrote, "The tension and restraint of public figures must not be relaxed. A sincere and practical apology is essential," and "I offer my condolences to those affected by historical victims such as the Inhyukdang case and their families." He added, "I will take this as a lesson, and both I and all members of the party will add more caution and gravity to our words and actions." (김 대표는 이날 페이스북에 글을 올려 “공인의 긴장과 절제는 풀어지면 안 된다. 최상의 실질적 반성과 사과가 필수적”이라며 “인혁당 등 역사적 피해자 관련자와 가족들께 위로를 보낸다”고 했다. 이어 “반면교사로 삼아 저도, 당 모든 구성원들도, 언행에 신중과 무게를 더하겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

The previous day, current affairs commentator Kim Jun-il, appearing on the show's "Genre Only Yeouido" channel, said regarding the new name of the Jo Kuk Innovation Party, "Progressive Innovation Party or Democratic Innovation Party would also be fine." When a fellow panelist abbreviated it to "Minhyukdang," he remarked, "Minhyukdang, it feels like everyone would be sentenced to death." The Inhyukdang case, which sounds similar to "Minhyukdang," refers to the Park Chung-hee regime's 1975 designation of a non-existent "Inhyukdang Reconstruction Committee" as the mastermind behind the National Federation of Democratic Youth and Students, which had fought against the Yushin system, and the execution of eight implicated individuals 18 hours after the Supreme Court confirmed their death sentences. They were acquitted in 2007 through a retrial. (전날 이 방송의 ‘장르만 여의도’ 채널에 출연한 시사평론가 김준일씨는 조국혁신당의 새 당명으로 “진보혁신당 아니면 민주혁신당도 괜찮다”며 함께 출연한 패널이 이를 줄여 “민혁당”이라고 하자 “민혁당, 다 사형당할 것 같은 느낌인데”라고 말했다. ‘민혁당’과 발음이 비슷한 인혁당 사건은 박정희 정권이 1975년 유신 반대 투쟁을 벌였던 전국민주청년학생총연맹(민청학련)의 배후로 실체가 없는 ‘인혁당 재건위’를 지목하고, 연루자 8명을 대법원 사형 확정판결 18시간 만에 처형한 사건이다. 이들은 2007년 재심을 통해 무죄를 선고받았다.)

The Jo Kuk Innovation Party stated, "We express deep regret and strong outrage over remarks that distorted our party's name and trivialized and mocked the victims of the Inhyukdang case, part of Korea's democratization movement history," and announced it would pursue legal and administrative measures to hold those responsible accountable. (조국혁신당은 “본 당의 당명을 왜곡하고, 대한민국 민주화 운동사인 인혁당 사건 피해자들을 희화화하고 조롱한 발언에 대해 깊은 유감과 함께 강력한 분노를 표한다”며 법적·행정적 수단을 강구해 책임을 묻겠다고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Jung Chung-rae during party workshop: "Kim Min-seok's rude and violent microphone dictatorship" (정청래, 당 워크숍 중 “김민석, 무례하고 폭력적인 마이크 독재”)
item.description:
Jung Chung-rae, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea, on the 27th strongly rebutted against party leader Kim Min-seok, saying, "I express regret that he mentioned my real name at today's lawmakers' workshop and used it as a tool for his argument," and "Cutting off the beginning and end, listening only to what he wants to hear, and unilaterally asserting by naming a rival in the leadership race just to say what he wants to say is almost violent." (정청래 더불어민주당 의원이 27일 김민석 당대표를 향해 “오늘 의원 워크숍에서 제 실명을 거론하며 자신의 논리 전개 도구로 사용한 것에 유감을 표한다”며 “거두절미 앞뒤 자르고 본인이 듣고 싶은 말만 듣고, 하고 싶은 말만 하기 위하여 전당대회 경쟁자의 실명을 거명하며 일방적으로 주장한 것은 거의 폭력적”이라고 강하게 반박했다.)

In a statement posted on Facebook during the "2026 Regular Session Preparation Lawmakers' Workshop" held at the Inspire Hotel in Yeongjong, Incheon, Jung said, "My conversation with Representative Kim about so-called centrism was no more than a brief one-to-two-minute exchange on the floor of the National Assembly yesterday. I truly had no idea that a brief conversation yesterday would become material for today's presentation." (정 의원은 이날 인천 영종구 인스파이어 호텔에서 열린 ‘2026년 정기국회 대비 국회의원 워크숍’ 진행 중 페이스북에 입장문을 내어 “소위 중도론에 대해 김 대표와 대화를 나눈 것은 어제 (국회) 본회의장에서 불과 1~2분의 대화가 전부다. 어제 잠깐의 대화가 오늘 프리젠테이션의 소재가 될 줄은 정말 몰랐다”고 말했다.)

Earlier, at the workshop, Kim had said, "Former Representative Jung Chung-rae is a leading proponent of 'there is no center,' but in contrast, with conservative forces having moved entirely to the extreme right after December 3 (martial law), if we go as far as a 'structural majority' that expands that territory and makes it structural, there are two paths to the victory and re-taking of power we seek," and "In talking with former Representative Jung, we reached a provisional conclusion that while we could resolve misunderstandings on other issues, the questions of centrism and the structural majority are difficult to reconcile with each other." (앞서 김 대표는 워크숍에서 “정청래 전 대표는 대표적인 ‘중도는 없다’론자인데, 그에 반해 12·3 (계엄) 이후에 보수 세력이 완전히 극단 우측으로 가버린 상황에서 그 영역을 확장하고 아예 구조적으로 만드는 ‘구조적 다수’까지 간다면 우리가 원하는 승리와 재집권의 길로 갈 수 있다는 두 가지 길이 있다”며 “정 전 대표님과 이야기를 하면서 다른 부분은 다 오해를 해소할 수 있는데, 중도에 대한 문제와 구조적 다수에 대한 문제는 서로 절충하기가 어렵다는 잠정적 결론을 서로 내렸다”고 말했다.)

In response, Jung said, "My statement that 'there is no center' has a premise. It means that when the ruling party acts like a ruling party, the so-called center supports the ruling party, and when the opposition acts like an opposition, it supports the opposition. In effect, there is no center, and it should be seen as a swing voter bloc," adding, "My claim is a topic for discussion, not something the party leader should grab the microphone and unilaterally condemn as 'your argument is wrong.' This is a microphone dictatorship." (정 의원은 이에 대해 “내가 말한 '중도는 없다'는 말은 전제가 있다. 여당은 여당다울 때 소위 중도가 여당을 지지하고 야당이 야당다울 때 야당을 지지한다는 의미다. 사실상 중도는 없고 스윙보터 세력이라고 보아야 한다는 의미”라며 “나의 이런 주장은 토론의 주제이지 당 대표가 마이크를 잡고 혼자 일방적으로 ‘너의 주장을 틀렸다’는 식으로 매도할 주제는 아니”라며 “이것은 마이크 독재”라고 말했다.)

He added, "I had serious concerns that responding to Representative Kim's rude and violent microphone dictatorship might spark internal party strife, but I was deeply worried that if I didn't speak up today, Kim's logic and arguments would become entrenched as if they were absolute values, so I am pointing out the problem to foster healthy debate on the party's direction." (그러면서 “김 대표의 무례하고 폭력적인 마이크 독재에 대한 대응이 자칫 당내 분란으로 이어지지 않을까 하는 심각한 고뇌가 있었지만, 오늘 이 얘기를 하지 않으면 김 대표의 논리와 주장이 절대적 가치인 양 굳어지지 않을까 심히 걱정돼 건강한 노선 토론 활성화 차원에서 문제를 지적해 둔다”고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Breaking] 9 of 10 South Koreans stranded in Nepal transported to safe area ([속보] 네팔 고립됐던 한국인 10명 중 9명 안전지역 이송)
item.description:
Nine of the ten South Koreans who had been stranded due to landslides and flooding in Nepal were transported to safety on the 27th. Foreign Minister Cho Hyun spoke by phone with Nepali Foreign Minister Sisir Kanal the same day, requesting the Nepali government's active attention and support in searching for and rescuing South Korean nationals who went missing after flooding while constructing a dam in the area. (네팔에서 산사태와 홍수로 고립되어 구조를 기다리던 한국인 10명 중 9명이 27일 안전지역으로 이송됐다. 조현 외교부 장관은 이날 시시르 커날 네팔 외교장관과 통화하면서 현지에서 댐을 건설하다 홍수로 실종된 우리 국민 수색과 구조를 위한 네팔 정부의 적극적 관심과 지원을 요청했다.)

The foreign ministry issued a notice stating that nine of the ten South Koreans, who had been awaiting rescue after being isolated by the previous day's landslides and flooding, were transported to a safe area by Nepali military helicopters that day, while a Doosan Enerbility site manager and two embassy staff members remain on-site. (외교부는 공지를 내어 전날 일어난 산사태와 홍수로 고립돼 구조를 기다리던 한국인 10명 중 9명이 이날 네팔군 헬기로 안전지역으로 이송됐으며, 현지에는 두산에너빌리티 소속 현장소장과 대사관 직원 2명이 남아 있다고 밝혔다.)

During his phone call with Nepali Foreign Minister Kanal that afternoon, Minister Cho requested the Nepali government's active attention and support for the search and rescue of South Korean nationals. The foreign ministry said Kanal explained the scale of damage and response status of the flooding in the Rasuwa region, and Minister Cho conveyed deep condolences to the Nepali people and bereaved families affected by the flooding. Minister Cho also stated he would provide humanitarian aid worth $1 million (approximately 1.38 billion won) through international organizations operating in the area to support the Nepali government's swift response and early recovery efforts. (조 장관은 이날 오후 커날 네팔 외교장관과의 통화에서 우리 국민 수색과 구조를 위한 네팔 정부의 적극적인 관심과 지원을 요청했다. 커날 장관은 라수와 지역에서 발생한 홍수의 피해 규모와 대응 현황 등에 대해 설명했고, 조 장관은 이번 홍수로 피해를 입은 네팔 국민과 유가족들에게 깊은 위로를 전했다고 외교부는 밝혔다. 조 장관은 이어 네팔 정부의 신속한 대응과 조기 복구 노력을 지원하기 위해, 현지에서 활동 중인 국제기구를 통해 100만달러(약 13억8천만원) 규모의 인도적 지원을 제공하겠다고 했다.)

Minister Cho emphasized that there is great concern as contact has been lost with nine South Korean nationals, and requested the Nepali government's special attention and support for a swift and safe search and rescue operation. (조 장관은 우리 국민 9명의 연락이 두절돼 우려가 큰 상황임을 강조하며, 신속하고 안전한 수색과 구조를 위한 네팔 정부의 각별한 관심과 지원을 요청했다.)

In particular, Minister Cho noted that President Lee Jae-myung had held an emergency meeting that day and issued directives to mobilize all available means to devote full efforts to searching for and rescuing the missing, adding that the dispatch of South Korea's overseas emergency relief team would also be reviewed and pursued. The foreign ministry reported that Minister Cho also urged the Nepali government's active cooperation at the government level to ensure the joint rapid response team dispatched to Nepal that day could work closely with local authorities and facilitate smooth search and rescue support activities for South Korean nationals. (특히 조 장관은 이재명 대통령이 이날 긴급회의를 열고 가용한 모든 수단을 동원하여 실종자 수색과 구조에 총력을 다한다는 지침이 결정되었다면서, 대한민국 해외긴급구호대의 신속한 파견도 검토·추진해나가겠다고 했다. 이날 네팔 현지로 급파한 정부 합동 신속대응팀이 현지 당국과 긴밀히 협력하면서 우리 국민 수색과 구조 지원 활동이 원활하게 이루어질 수 있도록 네팔 정부 차원의 적극적인 협조도 당부했다고 외교부는 전했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok expands his horizon with 'New ABC Theory'... "Without a shift in the baseline, we cannot sustain governing" (김민석, 외연 확장 ‘뉴 ABC론’…“영점 이동 없인 집권 지속 못 해”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea held its first lawmaker workshop since the launch of the 'Kim Min-seok leadership system' to reorganize its ranks. Chairman Kim emphasized an 'expansion strategy,' arguing that the party must broaden its base beyond traditional supporters to include moderates and conservatives. (더불어민주당이 ‘김민석 대표 체제’ 출범 뒤 처음으로 국회의원 워크숍을 열고 전열 정비에 나섰다. 김 대표는 전통적 지지층을 넘어 중도·보수까지 외연을 넓혀야 한다는 ‘확장 전략’을 강조했다.)

Speaking at the 'Regular Session Preparatory Lawmaker Workshop' held at the Inspire Hotel in Yeongjong-gu, Incheon, on the 27th, Chairman Kim said, "This party convention was more intense than ever because it came down to a difference in methodology. Former leader Jung Chung-rae took the position that 'there is no middle ground' and that 'our camp must unite to win.'" He added, "The 'livelihood, pragmatism, and expansion' line is our party's line, and it is the line of the party that has gone through this convention." Kim continued, "I believe President Lee Jae-myung and I share similar thoughts — we need to expand into the moderate and conservative camps beyond our traditional support base." (김 대표는 27일 인천 영종구 인스파이어 호텔에서 열린 ‘정기국회 대비 국회의원 워크숍’에서 “이번 전당대회는 어느 때보다도 치열했는데 그 이유는 방법론의 차이 때문이었다. 정청래 전 대표는 ‘중도는 없다’, ‘우리 진영이 단결해야 승리할 수 있다’고 보는 입장이었다”며 “‘민생·실용·확장’ 노선이 우리 정부의 노선이고 이번 전당대회를 거친 당의 노선”이라고 말했다. 김 대표는 “저나 (이재명) 대통령님도 비슷한 생각일 거라 보는데, 원래의 전통적 지지 기반에 중도·보수로의 확장이 필요하다”고 덧붙였다.)

Chairman Kim stated, "We need to understand that we stand in different positions and align on the direction we must take. This requires a 'shift in the baseline' — something distinct from simple political engineering like coalitions or mergers." He emphasized that the 'New ABC Theory' — Affordability (livelihood politics), Broadening (large and expansive addition politics), and Competence (competent politics) — serves as a new methodology to replace author Yoo Si-min's 'Old ABC Theory.' (김 대표는 “서 있는 자리가 다름을 이해하고 가야 할 방향을 맞춰가는 게 필요하다. 연대나 합당과 같은 단순 정치공학과는 다른 ‘영점 이동’이 필요하다”며 먹고사는 민생 정치(Affordability), 크고 넓은 덧셈·확장 정치(Broadening), 유능한 정치(Competence)라는 ‘뉴 에이비시(new ABC)론’을 유시민 작가의 ‘올드 에비시론’을 대체할 새로운 방법론이라고 강조했다.)

He said, "If we, along with lawmakers, supporters, and party members, do not achieve a generational shift through our efforts that makes a structural shift in the baseline possible, it will be difficult for our party to continue to take charge of state affairs five or ten years from now." He also noted that the late former President Kim Dae-jung's secret to achieving a second term lay in 'structural majority' and 'shift in the baseline.' Chairman Kim delivered his speech in a lecture format for approximately 33 minutes while wearing a lapel microphone on stage that day. (그는 “의원들, 지지층, 당원들의 노력으로 영점 이동이 구조적으로 가능한 세대적인 변화를 해내지 않으면 우리 당이 앞으로 5년, 10년 후에 지속적으로 국정을 맡기는 어렵다고 본다”며 김대중 전 대통령이 정권 재창출을 할 수 있었던 비결도 ‘구조적 다수’와 ‘영점 이동’이라고 했다. 김 대표는 이날 연단에서 약 33분 동안 핀마이크를 착용한 채 강연 형식으로 연설했다.)

In response to Chairman Kim's remarks, lawmaker Jung Chung-rae expressed regret on Facebook the same day, saying, "Cutting off the beginning and end, only listening to what he wants to hear, and unilaterally naming his convention rival by name to make his own point — that is almost violent." (김 대표의 발언에 정청래 의원은 이날 페이스북에 “거두절미 앞뒤 자르고 본인이 듣고 싶은 말만 듣고, 하고 싶은 말만 하기 위하여 전당대회 경쟁자의 실명을 거명하며 일방적으로 주장한 것은 거의 폭력적이다”라고 유감을 표했다.)

The Democratic Party set the workshop slogan as 'Great Reform for Livelihoods, Great Transformation for Growth, Great Investment for the Future' and shared legislative tasks for the second-half regular session and plans for managing the political landscape. (민주당은 이날 워크숍 슬로건으로 ‘민생을 위한 대개혁, 성장을 위한 대전환, 미래를 위한 대투자’를 내걸고 후반기 정기국회 입법 과제와 정국 운영 방안을 공유했다.)

According to spokesperson Lee Ju-hee, Yoon Hee-woong, head of Opinions, who gave a lecture on 'Analysis of the Voter Landscape and the Democratic Party's Tasks,' analyzed that "The party must actively respond not only to the demands of Democratic Party supporters who want the president, government, and party to be in sync, but also to the demands and sentiments of the public. Unlike in the areas of livelihood, economy, and everyday stability, the party's advantage in real estate has been diluted." Kim Won-i, chair of the strategy planning committee, presented plans for managing the second-half political landscape, while policy committee chair Kwon Chil-seung outlined key legislative tasks for the regular session. Prime Minister Han Duck-soo also attended and presented the significance and implementation plans for the megaprojects. From the presidential office, Senior Presidential Secretary for Political Affairs Hong Ik-pyo and Political Affairs Secretary Jeong Eul-ho attended. (‘유권자 지형 분석 및 민주당의 과제’를 주제로 강연에 나선 윤희웅 오피니언즈 대표는 “대통령과 정부, 당이 호흡이 일치하면 좋겠다는 민주당 지지층의 요구뿐 아니라 국민 요구와 정서에도 적극 반응해야 한다. 민생과 경제, 생활 안정 분야와 달리 부동산은 민주당 우위가 희석된 측면이 있다”고 분석했다고 이주희 원내대변인이 전했다. 김원이 전략기획위원장은 후반기 정국 운영 방안을, 권칠승 정책위의장은 정기국회 주요 입법 과제를 각각 제시했다. 한성숙 국무총리도 참석해 메가프로젝트의 의의와 추진 방안을 발표했다. 청와대에서는 홍익표 정무수석과 정을호 정무비서관이 참석했다.)

The Fatherland Innovation Party also held its 'Regular Session Response Lawmaker Workshop' on the same day at Bears Hotel in Chuncheon, Gangwon Province. (조국혁신당도 이날 강원도 춘천시 베어스호텔에서 ‘정기국회 대응 국회의원 워크숍’을 열었다.)

item.title: Park Geun-hye Tells People Power Party: "Internal Division Is the Most Fearsome Enemy... Must Unite Around Leadership" (박근혜, 국힘에 “내부 분열 가장 무서운 적…지도부 중심 단결해야”)
item.description:
Former President Park Geun-hye attended a retreat for People Power Party (PPP) lawmakers held to shore up party lines ahead of September's regular parliamentary session, emphasizing unity. The unusual move of inviting an impeached former president to give a talk drew criticism from within the party as well. (9월 정기국회를 앞두고 전열 정비를 위해 열린 국민의힘 의원 연찬회에 박근혜 전 대통령이 참석해 단합을 강조했다. 탄핵당한 전직 대통령을 초청해 강연을 듣는 이례적인 상황에 당내에서도 비판 목소리가 나왔다.)

Park attended the retreat, titled "Overcoming Today, Opening Tomorrow: The People Power Party," held at a hotel in Goyang, Gyeonggi Province, on the 27th, and spoke for about 10 minutes. Appearing to a standing ovation from lawmakers, Park took the podium and stressed, "When fighting enemies outside, there is no more fearsome enemy than our own internal division. In difficult times, we must unite as one around the leadership and move forward." This emphasized unity under the leadership amid ongoing criticism of Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's leadership system within the party. ( 박 전 대통령은 27일 경기도 고양시 한 호텔에서 열린 ‘오늘을 딛고 내일을 여는 국민의힘’ 연찬회에 참석해 10여분간 발언했다. 의원들의 기립박수를 받으며 등장한 박 전 대통령은 연단에 서서 “밖의 적을 상대로 싸울 때 우리 내부의 분열만큼 무서운 적은 없다. 어려운 때일수록 지도부를 중심으로 일치단결해서 나아가야 한다”고 강조했다. 당내에서 장동혁 대표 체제에 대한 비판이 이어지는 가운데 지도부 중심의 단결을 강조한 것이다.)

She added, "For a caterpillar to tear through the narrow, dark cocoon of a chrysalis and fly away as a butterfly, it needs a time of desperate struggle," and said, "Although the People Power Party is struggling as a minority opposition party, if we face reality squarely and pool our efforts, we can gain the people's trust, become the majority party, and win back power." ( 그는 “애벌레가 번데기라는 좁고 어두운 고치를 찢고 나와 나비로 날아가기 위해서는 처절한 발버둥의 시간이 필요하다”며 “국민의힘이 소수 야당으로 어려움을 겪고 있지만 현실을 직시하고 힘을 모아 노력하면 국민의 신뢰를 얻어 다수당이 될 수 있고, 정권을 찾아올 수 있을 것”이라고 말했다.)

Park's attendance at the retreat was prompted by an invitation from Floor Leader Jung Joon-sik, who visited her home in Dalseong-gun, Daegu, on the 19th. This marked Park's first appearance at a party retreat in 14 years, since she attended one as the Saenuri Party's presidential candidate in 2012. ( 박 전 대통령의 연찬회 참석은 지난 19일 대구 달성군 자택을 찾은 정점식 원내대표의 초청이 계기가 됐다. 박 전 대통령이 연찬회에 참석한 것은 2012년 새누리당 대선 후보 때에 이어 14년 만이다.)

Earlier, during the June 3 local elections, Park had joined campaign rallies for the Daegu mayoral race when it became difficult. In January, when Representative Jang Dong-hyuk was on a hunger strike demanding the so-called "dual special counsel" investigations, she visited the National Assembly for the first time in nine years since being impeached over the state affairs scandal, persuading Jang to end his strike. Park's repeated returns to the political stage are seen as the result of a convergence between the internal interests of a divided People Power Party that has lost its focal point and Park's own desire to restore her political honor. ( 박 전 대통령은 앞서 6·3 지방선거 국면에서 대구시장 선거가 어려워지자 지원 유세에 나섰다. 장동혁 대표가 이른바 ‘쌍특검’을 요구하며 단식투쟁을 하던 지난 1월에는 국정농단 사태로 탄핵된 이후 9년 만에 국회를 찾아 장 대표의 단식 중단을 끌어내기도 했다. 박 전 대통령의 거듭된 등판은 구심점을 잃고 분열한 국민의힘 내부 이해관계와 정치적 명예 회복을 바라는 박 전 대통령의 속내가 맞물린 결과로 풀이된다.)

An undercurrent of discomfort was detected within the party. A second-term lawmaker from the Yeongnam region told the Hankyoreh that day, "It's possible to invite (Park) since she is an elder of the conservative camp, but there's a question about whether it's appropriate to bring her to a retreat at this point in time." This sentiment was also reflected in attendance at the retreat. Of the 109 lawmakers belonging to the party, about 10 did not attend the two-day, one-night event. Among the four non-mainstream lawmakers recently given the heavy disciplinary punishment of suspended party membership by the Central Ethics Committee, only Rep. Cho Kyung-tae attended, while Reps. Kwon Young-jin, Seo Beom-soo, and Jin Jong-oh were absent. ( 당내에선 불편한 기류가 감지됐다. 영남권 한 재선 의원은 이날 한겨레에 “(박 전 대통령이) 보수의 어른이니까 부를 수 있기는 한데, 시점상 연찬회에 부르는 게 맞느냐는 고민이 있다”고 했다. 이런 분위기는 연찬회 참석률에서도 드러났다. 1박2일 일정으로 열린 이번 연찬회에는 소속 의원 109명 가운데 10여명이 불참했다. 최근 중앙윤리위원회로부터 당원권 정지 중징계를 받은 비당권파 4인 가운데 조경태 의원만 참석했고, 권영진·서범수·진종오 의원은 불참했다.)

The Democratic Party of Korea also criticized Park's attendance. Floor Leader Han Byung-do said at a policy coordination meeting that day, "It is an irresponsible act that outright insults candlelight democracy and the constitutional order." ( 박 전 대통령 참석을 두고 더불어민주당에서도 비판이 이어졌다. 한병도 원내대표는 이날 정책조정회의에서 “촛불 민주주의와 헌정 질서를 정면으로 모욕하는 무책임한 처사”라고 꼬집었다.)

That day, Representative Jang said, "We must clearly represent the people's concerns and anger in the regular session and the parliamentary audit," and "We must thoroughly expose the mismanagement and tyranny of the Lee Jae-myung administration and present the right alternatives," raising his voice, "We must resist together with the people and block it together with the people." Floor Leader Jung Joon-sik also said, "The past year of the Lee Jae-myung government has been a year of destruction and dismantlement," and "In the regular session, we must verify and report in detail the reality of the destruction and dismantlement being carried out by the Lee Jae-myung regime." ( 이날 장 대표는 “정기국회와 국정감사에서 국민들의 걱정과 분노를 확실하게 대변해야 한다”며 “이재명 정권의 실정과 폭정을 낱낱이 파헤치고 올바른 대안을 제시해야 한다”, “국민과 함께 저항하고 국민과 함께 막아내야 한다”고 목소리를 높였다. 정점식 원내대표도 “이재명 정부의 지난 1년은 파괴와 해체의 1년이었다”며 “정기국회에서 이재명 정권이 벌이는 파괴와 해체의 실상을 낱낱이 검증하고 고발해야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: North Korea Reacts to South Korea-US Arms Deal... "Confirms America's Hostile Stance" (북한, 한-미 무기거래 반발…“미국 적대적 입장 확인”)
item.description:
North Korea has cited US weapons sales to South Korea and the US government's support project to document North Korea's human rights abuses, stating it has "clearly recognized America's unbridled expression of intent to remain perpetually hostile." (북한이 한국에 대한 미국의 무기 판매와 미국 정부의 북한 인권 실태 기록 지원 사업을 거론하며 “항구적으로 적대적이려는 미국의 거침없는 입장 표명을 명백히 인식했다”고 밝혔다.)

A spokesperson for North Korea's Foreign Ministry made these remarks on the 27th in response to a question from a Korean Central News Agency reporter. The ministry spokesperson said, "The reality shows without reservation how active and enthusiastic the US is in expanding new threats against North Korea," adding, "We will respond to hostile acts sternly, promptly, and powerfully." However, instead of issuing a public statement from high-ranking officials such as the foreign minister or defense minister, the response came in the form of a commentary answering a reporter's question, suggesting a lowered level of response. (북한 외무성 대변인은 27일 조선중앙통신 기자의 질문에 답하는 방식으로 이렇게 말했다. 외무성 대변인은 “현실은 미국이 새로운 대조선 위협을 확장해 나가는 데 얼마나 적극적이고 열성이 높은가를 유감없이 보여준다”며 “적대 행위들에 엄중히 그리고 즉시적으로 강력히 반응할 것”이라고 말했다. 다만 고위급인 외무상이나 국방상 공개 담화 대신, 기자 질문에 답하는 방식의 논평을 내어 대응 수위를 낮춘 것으로 보인다.)

The ministry spokesperson referenced the US State Department's provisional approval on the 21st of a deal worth approximately $125 million (about 173.5 billion won) to sell AIM-9X Sidewinder Block II air-to-air missiles and tactical guidance equipment to South Korea. It also specifically pointed to the State Department's announcement on the 17th of a project to document North Korea's human rights abuses and counter subversion and propaganda. These events followed US President Donald Trump's directive on the 16th to reduce South Korea-US joint military exercises, sending a message of dialogue to North Korea. (외무성 대변인은 지난 21일 미국 국무부가 한국에 약 1억2500만달러(약 1735억원) 규모의 AIM-9X 사이드와인더 블록Ⅱ 공대공 미사일과 전술유도장비를 판매하는 안건을 잠정 승인한 것을 언급했다. 지난 17일 미 국무부가 북한 인권유린 실태를 기록하고, 공작 및 선전에 대응하는 사업 공고를 낸 것도 콕 집어 언급했다. 이는 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 지난 16일 한-미 연합훈련 축소를 지시하며 북한에 대화 메시지를 보낸 뒤 이어진 일들이다.)

The spokesperson claimed this was "another example showing that America's hostile practices aimed at creating instability in our state and social system are persistent and continuous." They also said, "By approving the sale of various lethal weapons, the US has actively encouraged South Korea's war-fighting capabilities," and "Amid the accelerating military integration between the US and its allies in the Asia-Pacific region, the negative impact that US weapons sales to South Korea will have on the regional security environment cannot be overlooked." (대변인은 이를 “우리 국가사회 제도에 불안정을 조성해 보려는 미국의 적대적 관행이 지속성과 연속성을 띠고 있다는 것을 보여주는 또 다른 사례”라고 주장했다. 또, “(미국이) 각종 살인 장비 판매를 승인해 한국의 전쟁수행 능력 제고를 적극 부추겼다”며 “아시아 태평양 지역에서 미국과 그 동맹국들 사이의 군사적 일체화가 가속화되고 있는 속에 한국에 대한 미국의 무기판매 행위가 지역의 안보 환경에 미치게 될 부정적인 영향은 간과할 수 없다”고 했다.)

Hong Min, a senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification, said, "North Korea likely has both skepticism and expectations regarding President Trump's message," adding, "This statement may have been issued to determine whether Trump's resolve is a one-off or signals sustained change." (홍민 통일연구원 선임연구위원은 “트럼프 대통령의 메시지에 북한은 의구심과 기대치를 함께 갖고 있을 것”이라며 “트럼프 대통령의 의지가 단발적인 것인지, 지속적인 변화를 위한 것인지 확인하고자 낸 입장일 수 있다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lee Jae-myung's approval rating recovers to 50% range... Has it hit bottom and rebounded? [Gongdeok Pocha] (50%대 회복한 이재명 지지율…바닥 찍고 반등? [공덕포차])
item.description:
<<>> ()

A poll released on the 27th showed that President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating for state affairs has recovered to the 50% range. According to the National Indicators Survey (NBS) conducted by Embrain Public, KSTAT Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research and released on the 27th, the positive assessment that the president is "doing well" in running state affairs stood at 50%. This is a 1 percentage point increase from the previous survey in the second week of August (49%). ()

Former President Park Geun-hye, who attended the People Power Party's workshop that day, emphasized in her speech, "In difficult times, we must unite in solidarity around the leadership and move forward." Han Byung-do, the floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, criticized the People Power Party's invitation of former President Park to its party workshop that day, calling it "a truly bizarre regression to the past and an irresponsible act that outright insults candlelight democracy and the constitutional order." ( 이재명 대통령의 국정 지지율이 50%대를 회복했다는 여론조사 결과가 27일 나왔습니다. 엠브레인퍼블릭·케이스탯리서치·코리아리서치·한국리서치가 조사해 27일 발표한 전국지표조사(NBS) 결과를 보면, 이 대통령의 국정운영에 대해 ‘잘하고 있다’는 긍정 평가는 50%였습니다. 직전 조사인 8월 둘째주 조사(49%)에서 1%포인트 오른 수치입니다.)

After recently recording 30% levels, is President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating left with nothing but hitting rock bottom and rebounding? What is the real reason behind Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok's surprise resignation? What is the intention of former President Park, who emphasized "unity around the leadership" at the People Power Party workshop? We find out on 'Gongdeok Pocha.' Check it out at 7:45 p.m. on the 27th on YouTube's Hankyoreh TV! ( 이날 국민의힘 연찬회에 참석한 박근혜 전 대통령은 연설에서 “어려운 때일수록 지도부를 중심으로 일치 단결해서 나아가야 한다”고 강조했습니다. 한병도 더불어민주당 원내대표는 이날 국민의힘이 박 전 대통령을 당 연찬회에 초청한 것에 대해 “참으로 기이한 과거 퇴행이자 촛불민주주의와 헌정 질서를 정면으로 모욕하는 무책임한 처사”라고 비판했습니다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Please Meticulously Check if There Are Other Korean Nationals Affected by Nepal Floods" (이 대통령 “네팔 홍수 피해 한국민 더 없는지 꼼꼼히 체크해달라”)
item.description:
As nine Korean nationals remain out of contact due to the sudden floods in Nepal, President Lee Jae-myung said on the 27th, "Please mobilize all available resources and do your utmost, with the resolve that there is no such thing as overreaction when it comes to protecting the lives and safety of our people." (이재명 대통령이 27일 네팔에서 발생한 기습 홍수 탓에 한국인 9명이 연락 두절 상태인 가운데 “국민의 생명과 안전을 지키는 일에는 ​과잉 대응은 없다는 각오로 가용 자원을 총동원해 최선을 다해주기 바란다”고 말했다.)

At an "Emergency Meeting on Response to Damage to Our Nationals Related to Nepal Floods" held at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs building in Jongno-gu, Seoul, President Lee said, "Please carefully check whether there are any other nationals affected besides those who have lost contact." The other nine were at a dam construction site near the river and lost contact as the floodwaters rushed in. item.title: Nine South Koreans unaccounted for in Nepal 'out of contact'; it's not confirmed whether they were in the building that was swept away (네팔 ‘연락 두절’ 한국인 9명, 쓸려간 건물에 있었는진 확인 안 돼)
item.description:
Nepal's military and police are conducting search operations for nine South Koreans who lost contact following landslides and flooding in Nepal, but as of 10 p.m. on the 27th (Korea time), their whereabouts remain unknown. Of the 10 South Koreans who had been isolated near the site, nine were moved to a safe area by Nepalese military helicopters that day. (네팔에서 발생한 산사태와 홍수로 연락이 두절된 한국인 9명에 대해 네팔군과 경찰이 수색 작업을 벌이고 있지만 27일(한국시각) 밤 10시 현재 소재가 파악되지 않고 있다. 인근 현장에 고립됐던 한국인 10명 중 9명은 이날 네팔군 헬기로 안전지대로 이동했다.)

According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, on the morning of the 26th (local time), an office and lodging facility primarily used by South Koreans, located near a river in the Rasuwa district of north-central Nepal, was damaged and the building was lost when a flash flood triggered a landslide. Nine people remain out of contact to date. They are employees of Korea South-East Power and Doosan Enerbility, which were involved in the construction of a local hydropower plant. A ministry official said, "We received reports that the power plant (dam) under construction was completely swept away, and the building (where staff were staying) was also lost." However, it has not been confirmed whether all nine were actually in that building at the time of the flooding or whether they were elsewhere. The area remains a danger zone, so only the Nepalese military and police have entered to carry out search operations. Because it is a rugged mountainous region, nighttime search operations are impossible. (외교부에 따르면, 지난 26일(현지시각) 오전 네팔 중북부 라수와 지역에서 기습 홍수로 산사태가 발생한 강가와 가까운 곳에 있던 한국인들이 주로 쓰는 사무실과 숙소가 피해를 입어 건물이 유실되고, 9명이 현재까지 연락 두절 상태다. 이들은 현지 수력발전소 건설에 참여한 한국남동발전과 두산에너빌리티 소속 직원이다. 외교부 당국자는 “건설 중이던 발전소(댐)가 다 쓸려 내려갔고 (직원들이 머물던) 건물도 유실됐다는 보고를 받았다”고 말했다. 다만 홍수 발생 당시 9명 전원이 실제 해당 건물에 있었는지, 다른 장소에 있었는지는 확인되지 않았다. 이곳은 현재까지도 위험지대여서 네팔군과 경찰만 들어가 수색 작업을 하고 있다. 험준한 산악지대라서 야간에는 수색 작업이 불가능한 상황이다.)

The 10 South Koreans who had been isolated were at a powerhouse, used as quarters for local employees, located a bit further from the river, along with about 200 local workers. Because it was on higher ground, they did not suffer direct flood damage, but they were all stranded after roads were washed out. A ministry official explained, "They were transported in four separate groups alongside Nepalese employees via Nepalese military helicopters by 5 p.m. on the 27th (Korea time) to a safe area, and they are scheduled to head to Kathmandu on the 28th." Among them, the site manager reportedly said, "I'll leave once all the Nepalese employees are rescued," and remained at the site. About 15 local employees are still at the site, and embassy consular and administrative staff also stayed behind. (고립됐던 한국인 10명은 강가에서 좀 더 떨어진 현지 직원 숙소 등으로 쓰이는 파워하우스에 현지 직원 200여명과 함께 있었다. 지대가 높아 직접 홍수 피해는 입지 않았지만 도로가 유실되면서 모두 고립된 상태였다. 외교부 당국자는 “이들이 27일 오후 5시(한국시각)까지 4차례에 걸쳐 네팔인 직원들과 함께 네팔 군 헬기에 나눠 타고 안전 지역으로 이동해 28일 카트만두로 갈 예정”이라고 설명했다. 이들 가운데 현장소장은 “네팔인 직원들이 다 구조되면 나가겠다”며 현장에 남았다고 한다. 현장에는 아직 15명의 현지인 직원이 있고 대사관의 영사와 행정직원도 함께 남았다.)

The government is also looking into the possibility that there may be South Korean tourists in the area besides these individuals. As of 2:30 p.m. that day (local time), no South Koreans were listed among the foreigners reported missing by the Nepal Tourism Board. (정부는 현지에 이들 외에 한국인 관광객이 있을 가능성도 파악 중이다. 이날 오후 2시30분(현지시각) 기준 네팔 관광청이 발표한 외국인 실종자 가운데 한국인은 없다.)

An 11-member government joint rapid response team, which departed from Incheon Airport and arrived in Kathmandu that day, is scheduled to meet with Nepalese government officials on the 28th for consultations before moving to the site. Foreign Minister Cho Hyun told reporters that day, "After the rapid response team assesses the situation, we can dispatch additional rescue teams in consultation with the Nepalese government. If we do, it will likely be a team of several dozen people." Minister Cho also spoke by phone with Nepalese Foreign Minister Shishir Kanal to request cooperation for the swift rescue of South Koreans and agreed to provide $1 million in humanitarian aid. (이날 인천공항을 출발해 카트만두에 도착한 정부 합동 신속대응팀 11명은 28일 네팔 정부 당국자들과 만나 협의를 한 뒤 현장으로 이동할 예정이다. 조현 외교부 장관은 이날 기자들에게 “신속대응팀이 상황을 파악한 뒤 네팔 정부와 협의해 추가로 구조대를 파견할 수 있다. 보낸다면 수십명 규모일 것”이라고 말했다. 조 장관은 시시르 카날 네팔 외교부 장관과 통화해 한국인의 신속한 구조를 위한 협조를 요청하고, 인도적 구호자금 100만달러도 제공하기로 했다.)

President Lee Jae-myung held an emergency meeting at the foreign ministry building in Seoul that day and said, "With the resolve that there is no such thing as over-response when it comes to protecting the lives and safety of our people, please mobilize all available resources and do your utmost." The president canceled his scheduled senior secretary meeting and instead held an emergency meeting on the Nepal flooding. The presidential office also postponed a luncheon between President Lee and ruling Democratic Party lawmakers planned for the 28th. (이재명 대통령은 이날 서울 외교부 청사에서 긴급회의를 열어 “국민의 생명과 안전을 지키는 일에는 ​과잉 대응은 없다는 각오로 가용 자원을 총동원해 최선을 다해주기 바란다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이날 예정됐던 수석보좌관 회의를 취소하고, 네팔 홍수 관련 긴급회의를 열었다. 청와대는 28일 하려던 이 대통령과 더불어민주당 의원 오찬도 연기했다.)

Senior Reporter Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr 서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party says "Tancheon is Tancheon-ro, Yongsan is Yongsan-ro"... Emphasizes Housing Supply (민주 “탄천은 탄천대로, 용산은 용산대로”…주택 공급 강조)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea on the 27th stressed that housing supply should proceed for both Tancheon and Yongsan Park, responding to Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon's proposal to use the Tancheon Water Reclamation Center site in Ilwon-dong, Gangnam-gu, as an alternative to Yongsan Park for housing supply for young people and newlyweds. (더불어민주당이 27일 청년·신혼부부용 주택 공급 후보지로 용산공원 대신 서울 강남구 일원동 탄천물재생센터 부지를 언급한 오세훈 서울시장의 제안에 대해 탄천과 함께 용산공원 주택 공급도 해야 한다고 강조했다.)

Floor leader Han Byung-do said at the party's policy coordination meeting held at the National Assembly that day, "What the public needs most right now is speed of supply," adding, "Tancheon should go its own way, Yongsan its own way—we need to find ways to utilize them for housing for young people and ordinary citizens." Han said, "How can the public accept (Mayor Oh's) attitude that a particular site cannot even be discussed?" and added, "We will not be swayed by Mayor Oh Se-hoon and the People Power Party's irresponsible stalling, and we will definitely complete follow-up legislation to the government's supply measures." This signaled the intent to push through housing supply at Yongsan Park as per the government plan. The previous day, Mayor Oh met with Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Kim Yoon-deok and mentioned the Tancheon Water Reclamation Center in Gangnam-gu, covering approximately 392,000 square meters, as an alternative site to Yongsan Park. <<> Criticism of Mayor Oh's Tancheon proposal also emerged. <<> Rep. Kim Young-bae, head of the Democratic Party's Seoul city chapter, said at a meeting with district mayors from the party in Yeongdeungpo-gu at the party's Seoul office that day, "The Tancheon Water Reclamation Center that Mayor Oh submitted as an alternative—when you look into it, housing supply is impossible without relocating it, yet he's doing render politics as if it can be supplied. The Tancheon Water Reclamation Center is a fanciful political claim that might only become feasible after 10 years." He added, "Mayor Oh is talking recklessly." However, Kim Won-i, chair of the party's strategy and planning committee, said at a lawmakers' workshop in Yeongjong-do, Incheon, that day, "We need to take a flexible attitude (toward Mayor Oh's proposal)." <<> Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Kim Yoon-deok reiterated the plan to build housing on part of the main Yongsan Park site in a CBS radio interview. He said, "Beneath the Children's Garden there is a hospital site. Wouldn't such a site be possible?" <<> Meanwhile, Mayor Oh, during questioning at the Seoul Metropolitan Council, reiterated that the Tancheon Water Reclamation Center could serve as an alternative to housing supply at Yongsan Park, saying, "Yongsan Park is green space reserved for future generations." <<> Shin Hyung-chul newiron@hani.co.kr Lee Ji-hye godot@hani.co.kr Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (한병도 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 당 정책조정회의에서 “지금 국민이 가장 절실한 것은 공급의 속도”라며 “탄천은 탄천대로, 용산은 용산대로, 청년과 서민의 주거에 활용할 방안을 찾아야 한다”고 말했다. 한 원내대표는 “특정 부지는 논의조차 할 수 없다는 (오 시장의) 태도를 국민이 어떻게 납득하겠는가”라며 “오세훈 시장과 국민의힘의 무책임한 시간 끌기에 흔들리지 않고 정부 공급 대책에 후속 입법을 반드시 마무리하겠다”고 말했다. 정부안대로 용산공원 주택 공급을 관철하겠다는 뜻을 나타낸 것이다. 오 시장은 전날 김윤덕 국토교통부 장관과 만나 39만2천여㎡ 규모의 강남구 탄천물재생센터를 용산공원 대체 부지로 언급했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: "Jung Cheong-rae Is a 'There Is No Middle Ground' Proponent"... Jung: "Don't Defame Me" (김민석 “정청래 ‘중도는 없다’론자”…정 “매도 말라”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea held its first lawmakers' workshop since the launch of the "Kim Min-seok leadership system" and began reorganizing its ranks. Representative Kim compared his own path with that of former Representative Jung Cheong-rae, emphasizing an "expansion strategy" that goes beyond the traditional support base to broaden the party's appeal to centrists and conservatives. This unfolded as former Representative Jung expressed regret on Facebook, calling it "microphone dictatorship," creating an apparent conflict between the current and former party leaders. (더불어민주당이 ‘김민석 대표 체제’ 출범 뒤 처음으로 국회의원 워크숍을 열고 전열 정비에 나섰다. 김 대표는 정청래 전 대표와 자신의 노선을 비교하며 전통적 지지층을 넘어 중도·보수까지 외연을 넓혀야 한다는 ‘확장 전략’을 강조했다. 바로 정 전 대표가 페이스북을 통해 “마이크 독재”라고 유감을 표하며 전현직 당대표 간 갈등하는 모양새가 연출되기도 했다.)

At the "Lawmakers' Workshop for the Regular Session of the National Assembly" held at a hotel in Yeongjong-gu, Incheon, on the 27th, Representative Kim said, "This party convention was more intense than ever because of differences in methodology. Former Representative Jung Cheong-rae is a proponent of 'there is no middle ground'" and "takes the position that 'we can win based on the unity of our camp.'" Kim then said, "The 'livelihood, pragmatism, and expansion' line is our government's line and the party's line chosen through this (convention). I believe President (Lee Jae-myung) and I share similar thoughts, and there is a need to expand from the original traditional support base toward centrists and conservatives." Kim added, "I have reached a tentative conclusion that it is difficult to compromise with (former Representative Jung's line)" and "It is necessary to understand that we currently stand in different positions and align our direction." He then proposed "zero-point shift" as the party's innovation direction, going beyond existing political engineering perspectives. Wearing a lapel microphone, Representative Kim displayed phrases such as "There is no middle ground" versus "Structural majority" on a PowerPoint screen and delivered a lecture-style speech for about 33 minutes. ( 김 대표는 27일 인천 영종구 한 호텔에서 열린 ‘정기국회 대비 국회의원 워크숍’에서 “이번 전당대회는 어느 때보다도 치열했는데 그 이유는 방법론의 차이 때문이었다. 정청래 전 대표는 ‘중도는 없다’론자”라며 “‘우리 진영의 단결에 기초해 승리할 수 있다’고 보는 입장”이라고 말했다. 김 대표는 이어 “‘민생·실용·확장’ 노선이 우리 정부의 노선이고 이번 (전당대회를 거쳐) 선택된 당의 노선”이라며 “저나 (이재명) 대통령님도 비슷한 생각일 거라 보는데, 원래의 전통적 지지 기반에 중도·보수로의 확장이 필요하다”고 했다. 김 대표는 “(정 전 대표 노선과) 절충하기 어렵다는 잠정적 결론을 내렸다”며 “현재 선 자리가 다름을 이해하고, 갈 방향을 맞춰가는 것이 필요하다”고 했다. 이어 김 대표는 당 혁신 방향으로 기존 정치공학적 관점을 넘어서는 ‘영점 이동’을 제시했다. 김 대표는 핀 마이크를 착용한 채 파워포인트(PPT) 화면에 ‘중도는 없다’ 대 ‘구조적 다수’ 등의 문구를 띄우고 강연 형식으로 약 33분 동안 연설을 했다.)

Former Representative Jung immediately rebutted Kim's remarks. He wrote on Facebook, "I express regret that my real name was mentioned and used as a tool for Representative Kim's own logical development" and "My argument is a topic for debate, not a subject to be defamed by a party leader grabbing the microphone and unilaterally declaring 'your argument is wrong.' This is microphone dictatorship." Choi Min-hee, a supreme council member aligned with the pro-Jung faction, also wrote on Facebook, "We win by establishing the party's center, first integrating and allying with democratic and reform forces, then working well with the Lee Jae-myung government to gain swing voters' support" and asked, "Is this a question of sequencing?" As the conflict escalated between the current and former leadership, Representative Kim wrote on X (formerly Twitter), "The tensions from the convention arising from methodological differences should be overcome together through healthy debate" and "If I caused any discomfort, I ask for your understanding." (김 대표의 발언에 대해 정 전 대표는 곧바로 반박했다. 그는 페이스북에 “제 실명을 거론하며 김 대표 자신의 논리 전개의 도구로 사용한 것에 유감을 표한다”며 “나의 주장은 토론의 주제이지 당대표가 마이크를 잡고 혼자 일방적으로 ‘너의 주장은 틀렸다’는 식으로 매도당할 주제가 아니다. 이건 마이크 독재”라고 불쾌감을 비쳤다. 친정청래계인 최민희 최고위원도 페이스북에 “당의 중심을 세우고 민주·개혁 세력과 먼저 통합·연대한 뒤 이재명 정부와 함께 일을 잘해 스윙보터의 지지를 얻어야 이긴다”며 “이게 선후의 문제일까”라고 적었다. 전현직 지도부의 갈등으로 비화되자, 김 대표는 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “방법론 차이에서 기인한 전대의 긴장은 건강한 토론으로 함께 이겨내야 한다”며 “불편을 드렸다면 이해를 구한다”고 했다.)

The Democratic Party shared its legislative tasks for the second half of the regular session of the National Assembly and plans for managing the political landscape on this day. Yoon Hee-woong, head of Opinion Live, presented poll results showing that about 70 percent of the 2030 generation believe the Democratic Party does not understand the younger generation, and said, "The veto sentiment among men in their 20s and 30s will be a variable in winning the general election," according to Rep. Lee Ju-hee, the party's deputy spokesperson for the floor. Cheon Jun-ho, senior deputy floor leader for legislative affairs, proposed price stabilization, real estate, small business support, and capital market reform as key tasks for the regular session. Prime Minister Han Deok-soo also attended the workshop and presented the significance and implementation plans for three mega-projects, including the Honam semiconductor cluster. From the presidential office, Senior Presidential Secretary for Political Affairs Hong Ik-pyo and Political Affairs Secretary Jeong Eul-ho attended. ( 민주당은 이날 후반기 정기국회 입법 과제와 정국 운영 방안을 공유했다. 윤희웅 오피니언라이브 대표가 2030 청년세대 70%가량은 민주당이 청년 세대를 이해하지 못한다고 답한 여론조사 결과를 발표하며 “2030 청년 남성층 비토 정서가 총선 승리 변수가 될 것”이라고 말했다고 이주희 원내대변인이 전했다. 천준호 원내운영수석부대표는 물가 안정과 부동산, 소상공인 지원, 자본 시장 개혁을 정기국회 대표 과제로 제시했다. 한성숙 국무총리도 워크숍에 참석해 호남 반도체 클러스터 등 3대 메가프로젝트의 의의와 추진 방안을 발표했다. 청와대에서는 홍익표 정무수석과 정을호 정무비서관이 참석했다.)

item.title: “Writing ‘Patience’ in an Empty Room Before Agreeing”… Yoon Suk-yeol’s Board of Audit and Inspection Found to Have Used Coercion and Manipulation (“빈방서 ‘참을 인’ 쓰다 동의”…윤석열 감사원 ‘강압·조작’ 있었다)
item.description:
A self-investigation released on the 27th found that, during the Yoon Suk-yeol administration, the Board of Audit and Inspection (BAI) used coercive questioning and manipulated statements while auditing the Moon Jae-in government’s “real estate statistics manipulation suspicions” (statistics audit) and the “West Sea public official killing case” (West Sea audit). (윤석열 정부 당시 감사원이 문재인 정부의 ‘부동산 통계 조작 의혹’(통계 감사)과 ‘서해 공무원 피살 사건’(서해 감사)에 대한 감사 과정에서 강압 조사와 진술 조작 등을 했다는 자체 조사 결과가 27일 나왔다.)

The BAI’s “Task Force (TF) for Follow-up Measures to the Special Committee on Government Audits” announced the results of its investigation into the statistics and West Sea audits that day, referring nine auditors to prosecution on charges including abuse of authority, obstruction of official duties through deception, and creating false official documents. The BAI also requested that the disciplinary committee impose heavy penalties such as dismissal or removal from office on these individuals. In addition, investigative reference materials on ten people—including former BAI Chair Choi Jae-hae, former Secretary General Yoo Byung-ho (currently an audit commissioner), former Secretary General Choi Dal-young, and Kim Sook-dong, former head of the Special Investigation Bureau who oversaw the statistics and West Sea audits—were sent to the National Office of Investigation of the police. (감사원 ‘국정조사 특별위원회 후속조치 티에프(TF)’는 이날 통계·서해 감사 조사 결과를 발표하며 감사관 9명을 직권남용과 위계에 의한 공무집행방해, 허위 공문서 작성 등의 혐의로 고발했다. 감사원은 이들에 대해 파면과 해임 등의 중징계 의결도 징계위원회에 요구했다. 또 최재해 전 감사원장과 유병호 전 사무총장(현 감사위원), 최달영 전 사무총장 및 통계·서해 감사를 책임졌던 김숙동 전 특별조사국장 등 10명에 대한 수사참고자료를 경찰 국가수사본부에 송부했다.)

The statistics audit was conducted for about a year starting in September 2022 over suspicions that “the Moon Jae-in administration’s Blue House and Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport exerted influence over the Korea Real Estate Board’s statistics compilation to manipulate the figures.” The TF investigation found that the audit targeted “higher-ups” such as Kim Soo-hyun and Kim Sang-jo, former Blue House policy chiefs under the Moon administration, and Kim Hyun-mi, former Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, and that coercive questioning and statement manipulation were used against Blue House and ministry officials. A TF official said, “Evidence concerning directive relationships among senior Blue House and ministry officials is largely contaminated or considered illegally obtained.” (통계 감사는 ‘문재인 정부 청와대·국토교통부가 한국부동산원의 통계 작성에 영향력을 행사해 통계 수치를 조작했다’는 의혹에 대해 2022년 9월부터 1년가량 진행됐다. 티에프 조사 결과 해당 감사는 김수현·김상조 문재인 정부 청와대 정책실장과 김현미 전 국토교통부 장관 등 ‘윗선’을 타깃으로 청와대·국토부 관계자들에게 강압 조사와 진술 조작 등이 이뤄진 것으로 드러났다. 티에프 관계자는 “청와대와 국토부 고위급의 지시 관계에 대한 증거는 거의 오염됐거나 위법수집 증거로 보고 있다”고 했다.)

In fact, in January 2023, an auditor identified as A told a Blue House administrative official, “This audit is aimed at the (Blue House) policy chief and the minister of land. In simple terms, it’s like asking to borrow a road to attack the Ming dynasty”—a reference to Toyotomi Hideyoshi’s request to Joseon—and warned, “If you don’t cooperate, your public service career is over.” (실제 2023년 1월 ㄱ 감사관은 청와대 행정관에게 “이 감사는 (청와대) 정책실장과 국토부 장관을 목표로 진행하는 것이다. 쉽게 얘기하면 정명가도(일본 도요토미 히데요시가 조선에 명나라를 치는 데 필요한 길을 빌려 달라고 한 말)”라고 말하거나, “협조 안 하면 공직생활 끝날 것”이라고 한 것으로 드러났다.)

In May 2023, a ministry official identified as B, who had refused a mobile phone forensic examination, was pressured by auditors into sitting alone in an empty room for 30 to 40 minutes writing the Chinese character for “patience” (忍) in a notebook before reluctantly agreeing. Another auditor reportedly threw an interview transcript across the room and said, “You can’t answer questions like this.” (2023년 5월 휴대전화 포렌식을 거부하던 ㄴ 국토부 사무관은 감사관 압박에 빈방에서 30~40분간 홀로 수첩에 ‘참을 인(忍)’ 자를 쓰다가 마지못해 동의한 경우도 있었다. 조사실에서 문답서를 집어 던지고 “이렇게 문답하면 안 된다”는 등의 발언을 한 감사관도 있었다.)

The TF also stated that the request for prosecution in the statistics audit contained 220 cases where statements were quoted differently from what was actually said, or where third-party speculative remarks were recorded as definitive assertions without confirmation from those involved. In July 2023, auditor C was found to have repeatedly written false answers in interview transcripts, claiming that Ministry of Land official D had said “influence was exerted on the Korea Real Estate Board, distorting housing statistics,” even though D had never made such a statement. The TF reported that auditor C even invoked a past case in which a person under audit had committed suicide, creating an atmosphere of fear. This content was included verbatim in the prosecution request the BAI sent to prosecutors. Following that audit, prosecutors indicted 11 people, including former chiefs Kim Soo-hyun and Kim Sang-jo and former Minister Kim Hyun-mi, in March 2024, and the trial is still ongoing. (또 티에프는 통계 감사 수사요청서에 실제 진술 내용과 다른 진술이 인용되고, 당사자 확인 없이 제3자의 추측성 진술이 단정적 표현으로 기재되는 등의 사례가 220건이라고 밝혔다. 2023년 7월 ㄷ 감사관은 ㄹ 국토부 실장이 발언하지 않았는데도 ‘부동산원에 영향력을 행사하여 주택통계가 왜곡되었다’는 취지의 답변을 수차례 허위로 문답서에 기재한 것으로 조사됐다. ㄷ 감사관은 조사 과정에서 과거 피감사자가 자살한 사건까지 언급하며 공포감을 조성했다고 티에프는 전했다. 이 내용은 감사원이 검찰에 보낸 수사요청서에 그대로 담겼다. 해당 감사 이후 검찰은 김수현·김상조 전 실장과 김현미 전 장관 등 11명을 2024년 3월 기소해 현재도 재판이 진행 중이다.)

The West Sea audit, conducted in 2022 against the Coast Guard, the Ministry of National Defense, and the Ministry of Unification regarding suspicions of a cover-up of the September 2020 killing of a public official, was also found to have involved coercive questioning and illegal digital forensics. (서해 공무원 피살 사건(2020년 9월) 은폐 의혹과 관련해 해경·국방부·통일부 등을 대상으로 2022년 진행된 서해 감사에서도 강압 조사와 위법한 디지털 포렌식 등이 있었던 것으로 조사됐다.)

The TF said that most of the staff who carried out these audits belonged to the Special Investigation Bureau led by former Secretary General Yoo Byung-ho, who is currently in custody and indicted on charges of suppressing an audit on the presidential residence relocation. They are known as the “Tiger faction,” close to Yoo. The BAI plans to review whether to re-examine the statistics and West Sea audits based on the TF findings. If a re-examination is held, the outcomes of the earlier audits could be overturned. (티에프는 이러한 감사를 실시한 대부분의 직원들이 현재 구속기소(대통령 관저 이전 감사 무마 혐의) 된 유병호 전 사무총장이 주도한 특별조사국 소속이었다고 전했다. 이들은 유 전 사무총장과 가까운 ‘타이거파’로 불린다. 감사원은 티에프 조사 결과를 토대로 통계·서해 감사에 대한 재심의 여부를 검토할 계획이다. 재심의를 할 경우 앞선 감사 처분 결과가 뒤집힐 가능성도 있다.)

Some staff members who took part in the statistics audit and underwent the TF investigation issued a 13-page statement that day, strongly disputing the findings, saying, “We never forced coercive questioning or statements on those under audit.” They also claimed, “The fact that housing statistics were arbitrarily adjusted under external pressure was proven based on objective data and testimonies from those involved.” (통계 감사에 참여해 티에프 조사를 받은 일부 직원은 이날 A4 13장 분량의 입장문을 내어 “피감사자들에게 강압적인 조사나 진술을 강요한 사실이 없다”고 조사 결과를 강하게 반박했다. 또 이들은 “주택통계가 외압에 의해 임의로 조정된 사실은 객관적인 자료와 관계자 진술 등을 토대로 입증된 것”이라고 주장했다.)

Jang Ye-ji, Staff Reporter penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Foreign Ministry Appoints Park Jae-kyung, Ambassador to Zimbabwe, as New Ambassador to Nepal (외교부, 대홍수 네팔대사에 박재경 주짐바브웨대사 임명)
item.description:
The Foreign Ministry has appointed a new ambassador to Nepal, where nine South Koreans remain out of contact following severe flooding. (외교부가 대홍수로 한국인 9명이 연락 두절된 네팔에 신임 대사를 임명했다.)

The ministry announced on the 28th that it had appointed Park Jae-kyung, the current ambassador to Zimbabwe, as the new ambassador to Nepal. A ministry official, considering the current situation in Nepal, said, "The new ambassador is expected to depart this weekend and assume the post promptly." (외교부는 28일 주네팔대사에 박재경 주짐바브웨대사를 임명했다고 밝혔다. 외교부 당국자는 현재 네팔 상황을 고려해 “신임 대사는 주말 중 이동해 신속히 부임할 예정”이라고 말했다.)

The South Korean Embassy in Nepal had been operating under a charge d'affaires system after the previous ambassador, Park Tae-young, was recently transferred to serve as consul general in Istanbul. As a small mission with six officials including the charge d'affaires, concerns were raised that it lacked the capacity to respond to incidents involving South Koreans who were out of contact or stranded. The new ambassador, Park Jae-kyung, joined the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in 1994 and has served as minister-counselor at the Embassy in Indonesia, Director-General for ASEAN Affairs, and Ambassador to Zimbabwe. (주네팔대사관은 전임 박태영 대사가 최근 주이스탄불 총영사로 발령이 나 이임한 뒤 대사대리 체제로 운영되고 있었다. 공관은 대사대리 포함 공무원 6명이 근무하는 소규모 공관이라 한국인 연락 두절·고립 사고에 대응하기에 여력이 부족하다는 우려가 나왔다. 신임 박재경 대사는 1994년 외무부에 입부한 뒤 주인도네시아공사 참사관, 아세안국장, 주짐바브웨대사 등을 역임했다.)

As of now, nine South Koreans remain out of contact following the flooding that struck Nepal on the 26th. Of the ten South Koreans who had been stranded in the area, nine were transported to a safe location via a Nepalese military helicopter on the 27th and are scheduled to move to Kathmandu on the 28th. The remaining individual, a site manager employed by Doosan Enerbility, decided to stay at the site until all local staff had been rescued. item.title: South Korea, U.S., and Japan to Conduct 'Freedom Edge' Drills Southeast of Jeju, July 7-11, Targeting China (한·미·일, 중국 겨냥 ‘프리덤 에지’ 내달 7~11일 제주 동남쪽서 실시)
item.description:
South Korea, the United States, and Japan have announced they will conduct the 2026 Freedom Edge exercise, a multi-domain training, from September 7 to 11 in international waters east and south of Jeju Island. (한국, 미국, 일본은 9월7일부터 11일까지 제주 동·남방 공해상에서 다영역 훈련인 2026년 프리덤 에지 훈련을 시행할 예정이라고 밝혔다.)

Military authorities stated that this exercise is an annual, defense-oriented training conducted by the three nations to respond to North Korea's nuclear and missile threats and to uphold peace and stability in the region. Under the agreement reached at the Camp David trilateral summit among South Korea, the U.S., and Japan in August 2023, the three countries carried out this exercise in international waters near Jeju in June and November 2024, and again in September last year. When the U.S. Indo-Pacific Command announced plans for the Freedom Edge exercise last September, it stated that trilateral cooperation would "strengthen capabilities within the first island chain," highlighting the exercise's nature as a check on China. This contrasts with South Korea's emphasis solely on "North Korean nuclear and missile threats" as the purpose of the drill. The first island chain is China's maritime defense line connecting the Korean Peninsula, Japan's Kyushu, Taiwan, the Philippines, Malaysia, and Vietnam. (이번 훈련은 북한의 핵·미사일 위협에 대응하고, 지역의 평화와 안정을 수호하기 위해 한·미·일 3국이 연례적으로 시행하는 방어적 성격의 훈련이라고 군 당국은 밝혔다. 한·미·일은 지난 2023년 8월 미국 캠프데이비드 3국 정상회의 합의에 따라 2024년 6월과 11월, 지난해 9월 제주도 근처 공해에서 이 훈련을 실시했다. 미국 인도태평양사령부는 지난해 9월 프리덤 에지 훈련실시 계획을 밝히며 3국 협력이 ‘제1도련선 내 전력을 강화할 것’이라고 밝힌 바 있다. 중국 견제 성격의 훈련임을 부각한 것이다. 이는 한국이 훈련 목적으로 ‘북한 핵·미사일 위협’만을 강조하는 것과는 다른 모습이다. 제1도련선은 한반도-일본 규슈-대만-필리핀-말레이시아-베트남을 잇는 중국의 해상 방어선이다.)

A multi-domain training reflects the concept of "Multi-Domain Operations." This concept means that the domains of the battlefield have expanded beyond land, sea, and air to include space, cyber, and electromagnetic spheres. (다영역 훈련은 ‘다영역 작전’(Multi-Domain Operations) 개념을 반영한 훈련이다. 다영역 작전은 전장의 영역이 지상·해상·공중에 더해 우주·사이버･전자기까지 확장됐다는 뜻이다.)

The scope of multi-domain operations is not limited to a specific region where a conflict occurs but is expanding globally. (다영역 작전의 범위는 분쟁이 발생한 특정 지역에 국한되지 않고 전 지구적으로 넓어지고 있다.)

Analyses suggest that the Freedom Edge exercise expands South Korea-U.S. combined operations, primarily focused on deterring North Korean threats and aggression, into the Indo-Pacific region. Following the instruction of U.S. President Donald Trump, the South Korea-U.S. combined exercise "Ulchi Freedom Shield," which ended on the 21st, saw its duration reduced from the original 11 days to 5 days. However, observers say the U.S. proceeding with the Freedom Edge exercise as scheduled is due to its focus on countering China. (프리덤 에지 훈련을 통해 북한의 위협 및 침략 억제를 위주로 하는 한·미 연합작전을 인도·태평양 지역으로 확대했다는 해석이 나왔다. 지난 21일 끝난 한미연합연습 ‘을지 자유의 방패’가 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령의 지시 뒤 훈련 기간이 애초 11일에서 5일로 줄었지만 미국이 프리덤 에지 훈련은 예정대로 하는 것은 중국 견제 때문이란 분석이다.)

The location for the Freedom Edge exercise is also in international waters southeast of Jeju (the East China Sea). This area is a passage for China's North Sea Fleet, based in Qingdao, Shandong Province, and the East Sea Fleet, based in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, to enter the Pacific Ocean. Thus, the trilateral multi-domain training continues to be conducted at a strategic chokepoint that could impede China's advance into the Pacific. (프리덤 에지 훈련 장소도 제주 동남쪽 공해(동중국해)다. 이곳은 중국 산둥성 칭다오가 모항인 중국 북해함대와 저장성 닝보가 모항인 중국 동해함대가 태평양으로 나오는 길목이다. 한·미·일 다영역 훈련이 중국의 태평양 진출을 막는 전략적 요충지에서 계속 실시되고 있는 것이다.)

item.title: Kim Min-soo "Who could dislike Park Geun-hye... Restoring her honor is a must-do task" (김민수 “박근혜 싫어하는 분 있겠냐…명예 회복 반드시 해야 될 일”)
item.description:
Kim Min-soo, a member of the People Power Party's supreme council, has claimed that "Restoring former President Park Geun-hye's honor is something that must be done again before history." (김민수 국민의힘 최고위원이 “박근혜 전 대통령 명예 회복은 반드시 역사 앞에 다시 해야 될 일이다”라고 주장했다.)

In an interview on YTN Radio's "Jang Seong-cheol's News Myeongdang" on the 28th, the supreme council member made these remarks in response to the host's comment that there was criticism calling the previous day's invitation of former President Park to the People Power Party lawmakers' retreat a "regression of history," saying, "They seem to be people who don't know history well." Kim also said, "No one has thought only of the country and the people as much as former President Park," and "That impeachment (of Park) was truly a political impeachment." When asked, "What methods could there be for restoring her honor?" he answered, "Politicians who can speak about this confidently just need to step forward." (김 최고위원은 28일 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오 ‘장성철의 뉴스명당’과의 인터뷰에서 전날 국민의힘 의원 연찬회에 박 전 대통령을 초청한 것을 두고 ‘역사의 퇴행’이란 비판이 있다는 진행자의 말에 “역사를 잘 모르는 분들인 것 같다”며 이같이 말했다. 김 최고위원은 “박 전 대통령만큼 국가와 국민만 생각했던 사람이 없다”며 “지금 (박 전 대통령에 대한) 그 탄핵이야말로 정치적 탄핵이었다”고도 했다. ‘명예회복에 어떤 방식이 있냐’는 질문에는 “이걸 당당하게 말할 수 있는 정치인들이 나오면 된다”고 답했다.)

When asked, "Haven't you been making efforts to cross the river of the Park Geun-hye impeachment all along?" Kim said, "I think it was cowardly." Kim added, "She was a president we created and we elected, but just because her political orientation differed slightly from ours, at that time too, our People Power Party, our conservative party, ended up impeaching the president. Isn't it that they decided to cut ties with the president to cross the river of impeachment and engaged in politics to survive themselves?" He continued, "From that point on, the conservative party walked the path of decline." (김 최고위원은 ‘그동안 박근혜 탄핵의 강을 건너기 위해 노력을 했지 않냐’는 말에는 “비겁했다고 본다”고 했다. 김 최고위원은 “본인들이 만들고 본인들이 뽑은 대통령인데 우리와 약간 정치적 결이 달라진다고 해서 그때도 마찬가지로 우리 국민의힘이, 우리 보수 정당이 대통령을 탄핵시킨 것과 같은데, 대통령을 손절하고 탄핵의 강을 건너자고 하고 본인들이 살아남기 위한 정치를 한 것이 아닌가”라며 “그 이후부터 보수 정당이 몰락의 길을 걸었다”고 말했다.)

Kim also shared the scene from the previous day when former President Park entered the retreat venue. Kim said, "As she was walking, she stopped briefly for me, shook my hand, and told me, 'I watch you on TV regularly.'" He also said, "The reporters were so delighted, they kept taking photos, with their mouths curving up in smiles as they shot," and "All the lawmakers applauded and welcomed her." Kim added, "Who could dislike former President Park?" and "Every time I see her, I just feel sorry." (김 최고위원은 박 전 대통령이 전날 연찬회장에 입장할 때의 상황도 전했다. 김 최고위원은 “(박 전 대통령이) 이렇게 가다가 저보고는 잠깐 정지해서 악수도 해주고 ‘티브이(TV) 잘 보고 있다’는 말씀도 해줬다”고 했다. 또 “기자들도 좋아서 막 사진을 계속 찍었고 입꼬리가 이렇게 올라가서 찍었다”며 “의원들도 다 박수치면서 환영했다”고도 했다. 김 최고위원은 “박 전 대통령 싫어하는 분이 있겠냐?”라며 “그냥 항상 뵈면 죄송하다”고 덧붙였다.)

item.description:
Kim Min-seok, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 28th at a lawmakers' workshop held ahead of the September regular session of the National Assembly, "Based on the outcomes of the debates that followed the party convention and the results achieved through the workshop process, we will achieve party unity and expand our reach," adding, "The entire leadership will work together for party unity and expansion." The previous day, Kim had explained the party's expansion strategy and said, "We reached a tentative conclusion that it is difficult to compromise (with former leader Jung Cheong-rae's line)," prompting Jung to push back, calling it "mic dictatorship." This appears to be an effort to defuse the situation. <<> At the supreme council meeting on the second day of the workshop, Kim said, "I ask all members of the leadership to offer ideas for party unity and to actively propose recommendations for personnel and ways to bring together various forces for expansion," adding, "We will discuss this together within the leadership." <<> Choi Min-hee, a supreme council member aligned with the pro-Jung faction, also said, "I agree with centrist expansion. No one will disagree with strengthening the core of the Democratic Party. The President also emphasized that the Democratic Party is one. We will do just that." She added, "In that process, we may make some mistakes, and differences of opinion may arise. But if there are reports that turn those differences into attempts to sow discord, we will respond firmly." She further noted, "However, we are aware of the derogatory term 'Munjo-teollyae' and some divisive actions stemming from it. We will deal firmly with such slurs, mockery, and hatred." Han Min-soo, another pro-Jung supreme council member, also said, "Now is the time for unity. I will keep us steady so that one-sided claims that undermine the unity of the Democratic Party no longer cause concern for our party members and the public." <<> Earlier, in his keynote speech on the first day of the workshop, Kim compared his own line with Jung's, emphasizing an "expansion strategy" that goes beyond traditional supporters to include centrists and conservatives. In response, Jung expressed objections on Facebook, saying, "I regret that my real name was mentioned and used as a tool for Kim's own argumentation." <<> Kim Chae-woon Reporter cwk@hani.co.kr (김민석 더불어민주당 대표가 28일 9월 정기국회를 앞두고 열린 국회의원 워크숍에서 “당은 전당대회를 거친 논쟁의 성과와 워크숍까지 이뤄지는 과정에서의 성과를 바탕으로, 당의 단합과 외연 확장을 이뤄가겠다”며 “당의 단합과 외연 확장에는 지도부 모두가 함께할 것”이라고 말했다. 전날 김 대표가 당의 확장 노선을 설명하며 “(정청래 전 대표 노선과) 절충하기 어렵다는 잠정적 결론을 내렸다”고 말하자 정 전 대표가 “마이크 독재”라며 반발한 바 있는데, 이를 진화하는 모양새다.)

item.title: [Breaking] President Lee's approval rating hits record low of 42%... Influenced by real estate policy [Gallup] ([속보] 이 대통령 지지율 42% 최저…부동산 정책 영향 [갤럽])
item.description:
A poll released on the 28th showed that positive assessments of President Lee Jae-myung's governance stood at 42%, the lowest since he took office. (이재명 대통령의 국정 운영에 대한 긍정 평가가 42%로 취임 이후 최저치를 기록했다는 여론조사 결과가 28일 나왔다.)

According to a survey conducted by Gallup Korea from the 25th to the 27th targeting 1,001 people aged 18 and older nationwide (with a margin of error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level, via telephone interviewer interviews), positive evaluations of the president's job performance were 42%, while negative evaluations were 50%. The positive rating is the lowest since his inauguration, and the negative rating is the highest. In the same survey last week, positive and negative ratings were each 45%. (한국갤럽이 지난 25∼27일 전국 만 18살 이상 1001명을 대상으로 조사(표본오차 95% 신뢰 수준에서 ±3.1%포인트, 전화조사원 인터뷰)한 결과, 이 대통령 직무수행에 대한 긍정 평가는 42%였고, 부정 평가는 50%였다. 긍정 평가는 취임 뒤 최저치, 부정 평가는 최고치다. 지난주 같은 조사에서 긍·부정 평가는 각각 45%였다.)

Reasons cited for positive evaluations included diplomacy (16%), economy and people's livelihoods (11%), communication (10%), doing well overall (7%), and real estate policy (7%). For negative evaluations, real estate policy (27%) was the most cited reason, followed by reduction of prosecution powers (7%), economy and people's livelihoods (7%), and moral issues and avoiding his own trial (7%). (긍정 평가 이유로는 외교(16%), 경제·민생(11%), 소통(10%), 전반적으로 잘한다(7%), 부동산 정책(7%) 등이 꼽혔다. 부정 평가 이유로는 부동산 정책(27%)이 가장 많았고, 그 다음으로 검찰 권한 축소(7%), 경제·민생(7%), 도덕성 문제·본인 재판 회피(7%) 등이 지목됐다.)

Party support ratings showed the Democratic Party of Korea at 39%, the People Power Party at 25%, the Fatherland Innovation Party at 4%, the Reform Party at 3%, the Progressive Party at 1%, and independents at 26%. A Gallup official said, "Compared to last week, the party support structure has not changed significantly, but this is the third time the ruling party's support has fallen below 40% in weekly surveys since the current government took office." (정당 지지율을 더불어민주당 39%, 국민의힘 25%, 조국혁신당 4%, 개혁신당 3%, 진보당 1%, 무당층 26%로 나타났다. 갤럽 쪽은 “지난주 대비 정당 지지 구도는 크게 바뀌지 않았지만, 현 정부 출범 후 주간 조사 기준 여당 지지도가 40%를 밑돈 것은 세 번째”라고 말했다.)

For more details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. (자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집을 참조하면 된다.)
